wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-007 adds the deterministic per-tic state-snapshot hash every final acceptance checkpoint compares against the reference. hashStateSnapshot(tic, componentBytes) computes SHA-256 per individual component (automap, player, rng, sectors, thinkers) and a combined SHA-256 over the canonically-ordered concatenation of the five digests, returning a frozen StateHashEntry keyed exactly to the read-only STATE_HASH_COMPONENTS. Pure and deterministic so acceptance runs replay bit-for-bit. The caller supplies the serialized component bytes (a later step wires the concrete serializers); this step pins the hashing + combined-digest-derivation contract. No read-only oracle/save module is modified.
